information: #### Welcome to the first ever WCA competition in Cadiz City. Whether you’re a first-time competitor or a seasoned cuber, this is your chance to join the growing speedcubing community of Negros Occidental, meet fellow cubers, and showcase your skills on the official stage. **Important Reminders:** - Competitors (or guardians for minors) must agree that the Organizers, PCA, and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage, or loss resulting from participation in this event. - Please read the **[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)**. - Check the **Competitor Guide and Updates** tab for announcements and changes. - See the **Events** and **Schedules** tabs for more details.
